item.description: Every Thursday, the Eat Off Art Studio at 2495 Main Street (TriMain Building – Suite 441) offers a “Come Make Art” opportunity for anyone that is looking to flex some creative muscle. item.title: Ruben Studdard joins the BPO for a Valentine’s Weekend Tribute to Luther Vandross
item.description: This Valentine’s Day Weekend, American Idol Ruben Studdard joins the Buffalo Philharmonic Orchestra (BPO) for an incredible night of music and soul. Studdard will perform the songs of one of his inspirations in a program entitled My Tribute to Luther Vandross. Luther Vandross was known for his velvet-smooth voice, emotional depth, and unmistakable approach to R&B ballads, and was widely regarded as one of the defining vocalists of his generation. item.title: Buffalo embraces winter with new ‘Made for Snowbuffs’ advertising campaign
item.description: What’s the opposite of snowbird? Could it be “snowbuff?” A new pro-winter-in-Buffalo campaign is underway to demonstrate that this city embraces its winter fully and unapologetically. Visit Buffalo has launched its ‘Made for Snowbuffs’ winter advertising campaign, featuring all sorts of “fun in the snow” imagery, including skating, sledding, cycling, and even paddleboarding.
